title: eludite.forge.refresh input
description: Refresh what the forge windows show now (the Refresh button): the pull request list, the issue list, one pull request (`number` or `id`) and the current branch's checks, waiting for the answers. Each failure keeps its cache and is reported. Read. The repository is the workspace's (its remote `origin`, or `remote`), detected as eludite.forge.detect does; every call runs on the forge worker off the UI thread with a timeout and stops when canceled. A call that needs a token when none is stored for the host fails with `sign_in_required: <host>`: the person signs in (Git > Sign in to <forge>); an agent cannot.

what.description: What to refresh (default the lists and the checks).

number.description: The number (GitHub, GitLab's `iid`, Azure DevOps, Forgejo, Gitea). Give `number` or `id`.

id.description: The item's `id` as a list answered it; Tangled's items have only this (their AT-URI). Give `number` or `id`.

remote.description: The git remote to read (default `origin`, else the only remote).
